value.rationale: Natural modal p-morphism quotient counts for finite circle-like reflexive orders are structurally motivated, not simple unconstrained walk recurrences. The exact edge-surjectivity criterion, exceptional K_2,2 behavior, and first zero-winding threshold exhibit non-obvious structure, giving interpretable all-parameter formula and sharp quotient existence test. Relates modal frame coverings to circular walk enumerators.
